title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Headquarters: Cyprus - Remote
 Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work. 
 Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.  
   About the Role: 
 You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike’s Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike’s AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.
 This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft. 
 Role Scope: 
 You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike’s agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.
 MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy: 
 Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
 Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
 Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
 Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.
 Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution: 
 Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
 Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
 Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
 Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.
 What You Will Help Shape: 
 A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
 GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
 A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.
 Your Impact: 
 Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers’ existing ecosystems.
 Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
 Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
 Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.
 Your Qualifications: 
 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
 Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
 Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
 Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
 Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
 Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.
 Why This Role Is Unique: 
 You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
 You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
 The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.
 What’s Next? 
 Introduction Call with a Recruiter 
 Conversation with the AI Product Director
 Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives
 Final interview with CPO and HRBP
 Benefits & Perks: 
 25 working days of paid vacation
 Sick Leave Compensation (5 Uncertified + 10 Certified Days)
 Parental Leave: Fully Paid Maternity / 4 Weeks Paid Paternity
 2 Volunteer Days
 Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
 Life Insurance (Employees)
 Provident Fund
 Hybrid Working Model
 School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)
 Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees

title: Cloud Architect, Product Management
description:
Headquarters: Seattle, WA (Remote)
 Cloud Architect, Product Management 
 Location: Seattle, WA (Remote) or Palo Alto, CA (Hybrid) 
 About the Role 
 We are seeking a hands-on, technically deep Cloud Architect to serve as the critical technical bridge between our Engineering, Product Management, and Field teams. In this role, you will act as the primary subject matter expert on the cloud services we support, ensuring our product vision translates into technically sound, commercially viable solutions.
 You thrive at the intersection of technical execution and product strategy . You’ll guide Product Managers during the product development process to ensure first releases of our features meet rigorous enterprise standards, while simultaneously partnering with field teams to ensure post-sale implementations land successfully in complex customer cloud environments.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Strategy & Design: Serve as the technical SME to help PMs translate complex cloud requirements into actionable product requirements and PRDs.
 Architecture Validation: Work closely with PM and Engineering to design and validate architectures and workflows that meet enterprise-grade performance and security standards.
 Implementation Excellence: Lead the "last mile" of product success by ensuring field teams have the right documentation, technical enablement, and architectural guides to make post-sale implementations successful.
 Hands-on Validation: Conduct hands-on validation of new features in lab and customer environments to ensure they solve real-world challenges before full-scale rollout.
 Field Readiness: Support the Sales Engineering and Professional Services organizations by validating field-facing content, including solution briefs, demos, and technical enablement materials.
 Trusted Advisor: Act as a technical consultant to key customers and partners, helping them navigate cloud architecture and integration questions.
 Qualifications 
 Required: 
 Experience: 10+ years of experience in Cloud Architecture, Sales Engineering, or Technical Product roles within a cybersecurity or enterprise software company.
 Technical Depth: Strong expertise in major cloud service providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, APIs, and identity services.
 Execution: Proven ability to go "hands-on"—you can perform deep-dive demos, validate complex integrations, and troubleshoot implementation hurdles in real-time.
 Communication: Excellent skills in translating technical nuances into business value for both executive stakeholders and technical practitioners.
 Collaboration: Comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and go-to-market teams in a fast-paced environment
 Preferred: 
 Specialization: Prior experience in cloud security, data resilience, or hybrid cloud infrastructure.
 Persona Knowledge: Experience working directly with Cloud Architects, or Security Engineering teams to solve architectural bottlenecks.

title: Product Manager, Procure-to-Pay
description:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.
 As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.
 By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco .
 About the Job
 The Product Manager owns strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) domain of the Zone & Co platform — covering procurement, vendor management, AP automation, invoice capture, approvals, and payments. Reporting to the Director of Product, this role spans the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and ongoing health of live features.
 You'll translate complex AP/procurement workflows (requisition-to-approval, three-way match, invoice capture, payment execution) into intuitive software built natively on Oracle NetSuite. This is a ground-floor opportunity in "Agentic Finance" — you'll spend more time in working prototypes than slide decks, using AI to move from insight to demo in hours, and you'll define how autonomous agents earn user trust in a domain where accuracy is non-negotiable.
 What You'll Do
 Define product vision and strategy for P2P, backed by market and customer research
 Own the roadmap — set OKRs and prioritize new features, enhancements, defects, and tech debt
 Lead development with Engineering and Design through the Agile lifecycle
 Drive Agentic AI integration — automate invoice coding, matching, exception handling, and approval routing, while designing guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints
 Prototype fast with AI, then turn what works into requirements, user stories, and quality evals for AI features
 Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy and enablement
 Ensure product logic meets global financial and tax compliance standards
 Monitor performance and iterate based on data and customer feedback
 Protect UX so complex workflows stay intuitive within NetSuite
 Manage backlog, stakeholder alignment, UAT, and internal training
 Use AI tools to summarize customer feedback from Support and Sales
 Evaluate third-party integrations and support technical debt reduction
 What You'll Need
 Required 
 AI-native: builds with AI daily and has shipped AI/agentic features to production
 5+ years in Product Management within Fintech, ERP, or B2B SaaS, with direct P2P/AP/procurement ownership
 Hands-on finance experience (practitioner or close partner to AP/procurement/controllership teams)
 Track record taking roadmaps from discovery to launch
 Experience owning a live, at-scale product — balancing new work against defects, escalations, and tech debt
 Strong Agile/Scrum skills and familiarity with tools like Jira or Productboard
 Proven success in fully remote, async, globally distributed teams
 Excellent communicator, able to translate compliance logic into simple software
 Preferred 
 Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable native ERP platform
 Familiarity with P2P/spend tools (Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com, Tipalti, AvidXchange, Ramp) and OCR/document capture
 Understanding of multi-jurisdictional tax logic (VAT/GST/Sales Tax)
 Finance/accounting/procurement certification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CPIM, etc.)
 Experience scaling products in high-growth (Series C–D) environments
 Benefits 
 At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.
 We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers 
 Join Our Global Mission 
 Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.
 Employment Terms 
 United States 
 Employment with Zone is “At-Will” , meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.
 Non-US Jurisdictions

title: Senior Program Manager SAP (all genders)
description:
DEINE ROLLE
 Programmsteuerung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung und Steuerung komplexer SAP-Programme und großer SAP-Projekte. 
 Führung: Als Teil des Führungsteams stehst du dem Vorstand beratend zur Seite und treibst Verbesserungen voran.
 Projektmanagement: Souverän steuerst du Großprojekte, Near- und Offshore-Projekte sowie unternehmensübergreifende Projekte und Programme.
 Risikomanagement: Risiken in kritischen Projekten identifizierst du frühzeitig und entwickelst passende Gegenmaßnahmen.
 Digitale Transformation: Du leitest Vorstudien, Implementierungs- und Rollout-Projekte im Rahmen der digitalen SAP-Transformation, mit Fokus auf Geschäftsprozesse in SAP S/4HANA.
 DEIN PROFIL
 Background: Du bringst langjährige fundierte Praxiserfahrung in komplexen SAP-Implementierungsprojekten mit.
 Projektleitung: Komplexe SAP-Projekte und -Programme hast du bereits erfolgreich geleitet und kritische Projekte sicher weitergeführt bzw. effektiv lösen können. 
 Kommunikationstalent: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, intern sowie extern.
 Reisebereitschaft: Du entdeckst gerne neue Orte - projektbedingte Reisen sind daher kein Problem für dich.
 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: (Senior) Project Manager – Data Centers (f/m/d)
description:
Job title : (Senior) Project Manager – Data Centers (f/m/d)
 Reference number: 45025
 Locations : Frankfurt am Main, Darmstadt (This position can be based in any Arcadis office location in Germany, while the onsite projects will primarily be located in Frankfurt or Vienna, depending on the project).
 Working hours: Full-time
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
 Role description:
 For our Project Management Team Technology in the Places Business Unit, we are looking for a dedicated (Senior) Project Manager (f/m/d) to support data center construction projects.
The position is located within our global Places business unit. Together with our customers around the world, we create, promote, and optimize intelligent, safe, and sustainable places where people live, work, learn, and succeed. Places influence people's quality of life—whether it’s housing, shops, workplaces, schools, hospitals, businesses, research and development facilities, or data and distribution centers. People and communities thrive when their living, working, recreational, and play spaces are designed and operated to best meet their needs.
 Role accountabilities:
 As (Senior) Project Manager and overall Project Lead you will be accountable for the end‑to‑end delivery of complex data center projects. You will drive scope, schedule, cost, quality and risk across all phases — from concept and design through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover — while ensuring technical excellence and seamless coordination of design disciplines.
 Lead the full project lifecycle for data center projects, taking overall responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk and client satisfaction
 Act as the primary client interface and executive escalation contact for project delivery matters
 Define project governance, commercial strategy and reporting structures; oversee procurement, contracts and subcontractor management
 Integrate and coordinate multidisciplinary teams (electrical, mechanical, structural, architectural, fire safety, MEP/TGA) to ensure coherent delivery of design and execution
 Oversee design management: review and validate key design deliverables, ensure compliance with German and international codes and client requirements
 Drive construction execution and site management, monitor progress, conduct regular site reviews and ensure health & safety compliance
 Manage commissioning, testing (FAT/SAT), system handover and closeout to secure operational readiness and contractual acceptance
 Monitor financial performance: cost control, change management, claims mitigation and forecasting
 Identify and implement value engineering, sustainability and energy‑efficiency measures
 Prepare and deliver regular executive reports and presentations to clients and stakeholders
 Mentor and develop project teams; foster a collaborative, solution-oriented project culture
 Qualifications & Experience:
 First and foremost, you share our passion for improving quality of life and for customer satisfaction. You take pride in the role you play in reshaping the world around you and understand the importance of teamwork. You are technically skilled, have relevant experience in managing building and infrastructure projects, and bring with you:
 Degree (Bachelor’s, Master’s or equivalent) in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil), Architecture, Construction Management or related discipline
 Minimum 6 years’ proven experience in senior project management roles for construction or engineering projects
 Significant experience with data center construction projects
 Demonstrated track record of delivering projects on time, on budget and to quality standards
 Strong commercial, contractual and procurement knowledge (tendering, contract types, claims management). Familiarity with VOB/DIN/HOAI and international standards is an advantage
 Excellent leadership, stakeholder management and negotiation skills
 Proficient with project controls and planning tools (e.g., MS Project, Primavera), cost management and MS Excel; familiar with BIM processes
 Strong technical understanding of data center systems (HVAC, electrical, fire safety) and ability to review design outputs
 Fluent English and German, both written and spoken
 Willingness to travel nationally and internationally
 Professional certifications (PMP, Prince2, RICS, CIOB) or equivalent commercial qualifications
 Experience with international clients and multidisciplinary delivery teams
 Why Arcadis?
 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.
